info.title: EXCLURAD pion-channel input at W=1.4 GeV

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Pion channel (ep -> e'n pi+): one point at W = 1.4 GeV, Q2 = 0.8 GeV2, cos theta* = 0.3, phi* = 120 degrees.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll preflight the requested pion kinematics against the configured lookup table and beam-accessibility limits, then generate the validated EXCLURAD input if it passes.

NOTE: eta and pion are different builds — point each channel at its own checkout.

parts.text: The server registers this reaction as `piplus` rather than `pion`. I will validate and generate the validated full O(alpha) input using the charged-pion campaign default beam energy, 5.75 GeV.

The pion request maps to the `piplus` build. Its preflight passes at the channel-default 5.75 GeV beam energy and 0.05 GeV² inelasticity cut; I generated the validated full O(alpha) input and am recording the run settings.
